streetName: Napa Valley Support Services - Imperial Way

facilityDetails.programFocus: Napa Valley Support Services enhances and supports quality of life for individuals with developmental disabilities through a person-centered approach to self-discovery, artistic expression, community engagement, employment, and education. The Imperial Way program specifically focuses on supporting individuals to maximize their personal and vocational potential, with a strong emphasis on community participation and employment.

parentReviews: Napa Valley Support Services' Imperial Way program has supported individuals with developmental disabilities since 1956.
The Imperial Way program focuses on employment training, with 70% of participants working in the community.
Imperial Way offers education, living skills, recreation, and social development for adults with disabilities.

facilityDetails.programFocus: Brown Street Gallery is a small, art-focused day program for individuals with developmental disabilities, where participants can earn income through the sale of their creative work. The program also supports individuals in increasing their independence and utilizing community services.

parentReviews: Brown Street Gallery is an art-focused day program for up to 30 adults with developmental disabilities.
Artists in the program can earn income through the sale of their creative expressions at regular art shows.
